note: LW2. What each spot is FOR, per physical scene — never where it is. tools/vr/measure-spots.mjs finds the position and facing by raycasting the real GLB and writes assets/vr-worlds/spots/<scene>.json; a spot it cannot measure is written verified:false and is never offered. near = regexes over the scene's top-level node names (the thing she stands by). room = the area the name belongs to. can = what is honestly possible there today: 'stand-near' and 'look-at' need nothing but a measured spot; nothing here claims sitting, lying down or handling an object, because no seat-aligned pose or hand-held prop exists yet. rating: 'general' or 'romantic' (Private rooms keep their own gates and are not listed here).
